summary: Live dependency previews in open windows now hold their values through a save until the Engine dependent update completes, instead of snapping back to stale values.
details: Saving an upstream method or dataset keeps every downstream window's previewed values on screen while the Engine job runs; the windows reload the refreshed persisted values when it finishes.
Duplicate clean-transition messages fired by a save no longer clear downstream previews early, which previously left dependent windows stuck on pre-save values.

A dependent-update job that leaves items needing review no longer raises a status-bar warning; the review-needed flags in the Project Instance dataset table are the failure surface, and the table refreshes automatically when the job ends.
If the job fails, downstream windows reload honestly to the last published values with their Review Needed status.
